sources.title: ralphex README.md
sources.locator: Features; Quick Start; Phase 1-4; Plan Creation; Usage; Platform Support
sources.finding: Standalone local CLI executes plan checklists, commits each task and runs configurable review stages. Linux/macOS supported; Windows source build is best-effort with missing signal/locking/process-cleanup behavior.

sources.title: ralphex README.md
sources.finding: Optional browser dashboard streams SSE output with phase filters, collapsible sections, text search and late-join full history. Watch mode monitors multiple progress files in a session sidebar. This is monitoring, not established browser control of execution.

sources.title: ralphex docs/custom-providers.md
sources.locator: Codex executor mode; Requirements; Wrapper path
sources.finding: Claude Code is default; native --codex mode needs Codex 0.130.0+. Compatible wrapper scripts support Gemini, Pi, Copilot, OpenCode or custom tools. Native reviews use provider subagent mechanisms; --codex skips external Codex review.

sources.title: ralphex README.md
sources.finding: Optional --worktree runs plans in separate Git worktrees; Docker wrapper mounts project/credentials with documented sandbox limits. Worktrees only apply to full/tasks-only modes.

sources.title: ralphex LICENSE
sources.finding: MIT license covers ralphex source at pinned revision.

sources.title: ralphex v1.7.0 release
sources.finding: Release published 7 September 2026; default-branch changes continue through 7 November.

sources.title: ralphex website
sources.locator: 'Where is ralphex on GitHub?'; footer; '--codex mode' FAQ
sources.finding: Says ralphex is open source under MIT and uses your own Claude or OpenAI plan. The site shows no price.

sources.title: ralphex README
sources.locator: Agent SDK credit note; options table (--preserve-anthropic-api-key); 'License'
sources.finding: Says unattended runs count against your own Anthropic plan's Agent SDK credit pool or API-key billing, or can switch to your OpenAI/codex plan. ralphex itself has no paid tier and is MIT licensed.

sources.title: ralphex Antigravity support at v1.7.0
sources.finding: Ralphex v1.7.0 ships agy-as-claude.sh, a configured replacement for Claude Code in task and review phases that translates Antigravity output into Claude stream-json.
